meta_title: JB Plastering | Plasterer Belle Isle Leeds
meta_description: JB Plastering in Belle Isle, Leeds. Expert plastering, rendering and decorative finishes. Free quotes, fast turnaround. Call 07471 478144.
hero_eyebrow: Experienced Plasterer — Belle Isle & Surrounding Areas
hero_subhead: Professional plastering, rendering, and decorative finishes for homes across Leeds. Same-week appointments available.
services_subhead: From internal walls and ceilings to external rendering and specialist finishes, we handle every plastering job with care and precision.

services.title: Internal Plastering
services.desc: Smooth wall and ceiling finishes for bedrooms, living rooms, and kitchens. We skim, fill, and prepare surfaces for decoration — ready to paint in days, not weeks.

services.title: External Rendering
services.desc: Durable cement and silicone renders that protect your property and improve curb appeal. Weather-resistant finishes built to last 20+ years.

services.title: Artex Removal & Ceiling Repair
services.desc: Remove outdated Artex safely and replace with smooth modern finishes. Ideal when refreshing period homes or updating dated ceilings.

services.title: Plasterboard Installation
services.desc: Fast partition walls and stud work for extensions or interior remodelling. Taped, jointed, and ready for decoration.

services.title: Patch & Repair Work
services.desc: Cracks, damp damage, or old repairs? We blend new plaster seamlessly with existing surfaces — invisible once decorated.

services.title: Decorative Finishes
services.desc: Textured and feature plaster work including venetian finishes, polished plaster, and bespoke design details.

about_pullquote: I take pride in leaving every home looking pristine, every time.
about_para_1: JB Plastering has been serving Belle Isle and across Leeds for over 15 years. Started as a one-man operation, we've built a reputation for clean work, punctuality, and honest pricing. Every job is treated with the same level of care, whether it's a small patch or a full house renovation.
about_para_2: Our customers come back to us because we show up when we say we will, clear up after ourselves, and deliver finishes that look professional from day one. We work on everything from Victorian terraces to new builds, and we're as comfortable with intricate feature work as we are with straightforward wall and ceiling skims.
reviews_heading: What Leeds Homeowners Say About JB Plastering

reviews.text: John came out to re-plaster our living room after we had the chimney removed. The walls looked rough but he made a beautiful job of it. Very tidy, finished when he said he would, and the price was fair. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: David T.

reviews.text: Had JB Plastering in to do some repair work and a ceiling skim in our kitchen. Fast, professional, and they cleaned up after themselves which not all tradesmen do! Will definitely call them back when we redecorate upstairs.
reviews.author: Sophie M.

reviews.text: Called John on a Thursday, he was round on the Friday and finished the job by Monday. New render on our garage looks brilliant. Good bloke, good workman. Top marks.
reviews.author: Michael B.
